commands: cat packages/server/src/core/middleware.ts; cat packages/tests/tsconfig.json; cat tsconfig.json; cat packages/server/src/core/initTRPC.ts

rg -n 'ctx:.*undefined|ctx:.*\?|next\(\{ ctx|next\(\{' packages/tests/server/middlewares.test.ts | head -60; cat tsconfig.build.json; cat packages/server/src/types.ts | head -100; nl -ba packages/server/src/core/internals/utils.ts | head -40
ls packages/tests/node_modules/@types | head; ls node_modules/@types | head; ls packages/server/node_modules/@types | head

mkdir -p ../clone-work/base; git archive main packages/server/src | tar -x -C ../clone-work/base
ln -s ../../clone/node_modules ../clone-work/base/node_modules
sed "s@../clone/packages/server/src@./base/packages/server/src@" ../clone-work/context-regression.ts > ../clone-work/context-base.ts
cat > ../clone-work/tsconfig.compare.json <<'EOF'
{
  "extends": "../clone/tsconfig.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "types": ["node"],
    "typeRoots": ["../clone/packages/tests/node_modules/@types"],
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": false,
    "noEmit": true
  },
  "include": ["context-regression.ts", "context-base.ts"],
  "exclude": []
}
EOF
./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p ../clone-work/tsconfig.compare.json
